Questions

Before you come up.

Who will do my hair?

The studio is Chrissy’s, and clients book with her by name.

How do I find the studio?

It is on the second floor of the Jonnet Building on William Penn Highway, in Suite 207.

My color went wrong somewhere else. Can it be fixed?

Corrective color is one of the studio’s services. Pick it in the request and add a note about what happened.
